summary: A good daily in both modes: everyone knows these countries, the Soviet Union and Sweden are the fair stretches, and Russia (#14) and Norway (#11) are near misses players learn from. It sits on the easy edge of the target.
reasons: Casual run found 8/10 in 13 guesses (USA, China, UK, Germany, France, Australia, Japan, Italy). Lives went on Russia #14, Canada #12, South Korea #18, Norway #11 and Brazil #29 before Sweden or the USSR came up. Other guess orders land on 7 to 9, so expect an average near the top of 5 to 6.

Russia counted apart from the Soviet Union is the talking point: nearly everyone loses a life on it, but 'of all time' is a fair hint and the reveal teaches something. The fan got 10/10, losing a life only on Norway (3 medals behind Australia).
All values match the Wikipedia table, including Milano Cortina 2026. UK, USA and USSR forms, Team GB, Aussie and common typos all work. In Blitz all 25 casual names scored.
fixes: 'american' matches American Samoa (unranked, no medals) and costs a life. Add 'American' as an alias of United States, like 'German' on Germany and 'British' on Great Britain. Add 'Team USA' too: it isn't recognized, but 'Team GB' is.
'chinese' matches Chinese Taipei (#56) and costs a life. Add 'Chinese' as an alias of China.

'Taiwan' is a separate unranked answer, so it costs a life and scores 0 in Blitz. Make it an alias of Chinese Taipei (#56). Same problem: 'U.S. Virgin Islands' is unranked, apart from 'Virgin Islands' (#162).
